Cambrian Capital Limited Partnership Maintains Stake in Anadarko Pete (APC); Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Kanawha Capital Management Has Cut Its Holding as Stock Price Rose
June 11, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Cambrian Capital Limited Partnership increased its stake in Anadarko Pete Corp (APC) by 30.71% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cambrian Capital Limited Partnership bought 17,600 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.90% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 74,916 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.53 million, up from 57,316 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cambrian Capital Limited Partnership who had been investing in Anadarko Pete Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $36.78 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.35% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $71.4. About 3.09 million shares traded. Anadarko Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:APC) has risen 29.81% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 17.24% the S&P500. The institutional investor held 91,470 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $15.35 million, down from 93,348 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
